verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for an observability SaaS that stores customer telemetry, but the pack never documents retention periods, retention configuration, or data-deletion mechanisms. The closest items are community reports of turning off default log collection: env vars, or 'log settings' in a Data Management Hub. A note also says nrdiag output isn't uploaded by default. All of these control what gets collected, not how long data is kept or how it is deleted.
